SELECT T4.FINPROD_ID finprodId, SUBT2.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, SUBT2.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, T1.CHL_ID chlId, T1.FINPROD_TYPE2, T1.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID, to_char(T1.TRADE_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') TRADE_DATE, to_char(T4.VDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') vDate , to_char(T4.MDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') mDate , T1.PRIN_AMT THEORY_PRIN ,
T4.M_INT_AMT THEORY_INT, T1.PRIN_AMT + T4.M_INT_AMT tradeAmt , T1.PS ,'质押式回购存续期-'||SAI.SEC_ACCT_NAME|| fp1.FINPROD_NAME remark FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T1 LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp1 on fp1.FINPROD_ID = T1.CHL_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_TRADE T3 ON T1.TRADE_ID = T3.BUSI_NO LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO T2 ON T2.PORTFOLIO_ID = T3.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_TRADE T31 ON T1.TRADE_ID = T31.BUSI_NO LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO SUBT2 ON SUBT2.PORTFOLIO_ID = T31.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO FCI ON T1.FINPROD_ID = FCI.FINPROD_ID AND T1.CCY = FCI.CCY AND FCI.CASH_TYPE_2 = 'C02' LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_PLAN FCP ON FCI.CASH_ID = FCP.CASH_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT T4 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T4.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE T5 ON T4.FINPROD_ID = T5.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO SAI ON T1.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID = SAI.SEC_ACCT_ID WHERE t1.TRADE_STATUS = '01' AND T1.FINPROD_TYPE2 IN ('F03', 'F02') and t1.IS_CANCEL = 'N' and t4.mdate <= #{checkDate,jdbcType=DATE} AND T1.PS = 'T01' AND T2.PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID is null AND SUBT2.INVEST_YESORNO = 'Y' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL TPD where TPD.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID AND TPD.PS IN ('T22', 'T23') AND TPD.FINPROD_TYPE2 IN ('F03', 'F02') and TPD.TRADE_STATUS = '01' and TPD.IS_CANCEL = 'N') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL TPD where TPD.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID)
and exists ( select 1 from data_auth_notify_inst dani where dani.business_id = subt2.portfolio_id and dani.model_type = '02' and dani.data_type = 'PTL01' AND dani.institution_code = #{PRE_INST_CODE,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )

with tmpTable as ( select T1.FINPROD_ID, T1.AMOUNT * NVL(T1.FACE_VALUE, 1) QTY, T1.CASH_TYPE, T1.CASH_ID, T1.MDATE, T1.CDATE, CASE WHEN T1.CASH_TYPE IN ('01', '04') then T1.THORY_INT_AMT else (T1.PRIN_AMT / T1.CASH_BASEAMT) * T1.AMOUNT * NVL(T1.FACE_VALUE, 1) + T1.THORY_INT_AMT end fpriceAmt, /*理论本息总额*/ CASE WHEN T1.CASH_TYPE IN ('01', '04') then 0 else (T1.PRIN_AMT / T1.CASH_BASEAMT) * T1.AMOUNT * NVL(T1.FACE_VALUE, 1) end prinAmt, /*还本金额*/ T1.PORTFOLIO_ID, T1.SEC_ACCT_ID, T1.THORY_INT_AMT intAmt, /*理论利息*/ T1.PAY_DATE FROM (select * from (SELECT T1.AMOUNT, t1.finprod_id, t1.sec_acct_id, t1.cdate, t6.cash_type, T6.CASH_ID, T6.MDATE, T6.CASH_AMT, T1.PORTFOLIO_ID, T6.CASH_BASEAMT, T1.FACE_VALUE, T6.PRIN_AMT, T6.INT_AMT, T6.PAY_DATE, case when t6.cash_type IN ('01', '04') then NVL(PSV.TDY_INTINCEXP, t6.INT_AMT * T1.AMOUNT * NVL(T1.FACE_VALUE, 1) / T6.CASH_BASEAMT) WHEN T6.CASH_TYPE IN ('02', '03') AND T6.INT_AMT is not null and T6.INT_AMT != 0 AND PSV.SHARE_AMT is not null THEN ROUND(T6.PRIN_AMT * T1.AMOUNT / T6.CASH_BASEAMT * PSV.TDY_INTINCEXP / PSV.SHARE_AMT, 2) else t6.INT_AMT * T1.AMOUNT * NVL(T1.FACE_VALUE, 1) / t6.CASH_BASEAMT end THORY_INT_AMT, rank() over(partition by t6.finprod_id order by t6.mdate) rank from PTL_SEC_POSITION T1 INNER JOIN FIN_CASH_PLAN T6 on t1.cdate < t6.mdate and t1.finprod_id = t6.finprod_id INNER JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO pp on T1.PORTFOLIO_ID = pp.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_SEC_VALUTION PSV ON T6.MDATE = PSV.CDATE + 1 AND T1.PORTFOLIO_ID = PSV.PORTFOLIO_ID AND T1.FINPROD_ID = PSV.FINPROD_ID AND PSV.INV_AIM = '999999' where nvl(pp.PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID, 'null') = 'null' and T6.PAY_DATE <= #{checkDate,jdbcType=DATE} AND T1.HODING_TYPE = '03' AND T6.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F07' and T1.AMOUNT > 0 and NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL tfpdt where tfpdt.TRADE_STATUS = '01' and tfpdt.IS_CANCEL = 'N' AND (tfpdt.CHL_ID = T1.SEC_ACCT_ID OR (T1.SEC_ACCT_ID = '999999' and tfpdt.CHL_ID is null)) AND T1.PORTFOLIO_ID = tfpdt.PORTFOLIO_ID AND t1.finprod_id = tfpdt.FINPROD_ID and T6.MDATE = tfpdt.MDATE) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL tfpdt where tfpdt.WORKFLOW_STATUS = 'N' AND T1.FINPROD_ID = TFPDT.FINPROD_ID AND (tfpdt.CHL_ID = T1.SEC_ACCT_ID OR (T1.SEC_ACCT_ID = '999999' and tfpdt.CHL_ID is null)) AND T1.PORTFOLIO_ID = tfpdt.PORTFOLIO_ID and T6.MDATE >= tfpdt.MDATE) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION tpsp where tpsp.HODING_TYPE = '03' and tpsp.PORTFOLIO_ID = T1.PORTFOLIO_ID and tpsp.SEC_ACCT_ID = T1.SEC_ACCT_ID and tpsp.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID and tpsp.CDATE > T1.CDATE and tpsp.CDATE < T6.MDATE )) where rank = 1) T1)
select t8.FINPROD_ID finprodId, fprod_type.TYPE_6 as assetType, t10.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, t10.FINPROD_NAME finprodName, t8.SEC_ACCT_ID chlId, TC4.FINPROD_NAME channelName, min(t9.VDATE) vdate, t8.MDATE , t8.qty remainPrinAmt, SUM(t8.fpriceAmt) tradeAmt, t8.PAY_DATE payDate , '存款存续期_'||nvl( TC4.FINPROD_NAME ,'直投') remark from (select T7.FINPROD_ID, t7.CASH_TYPE, t7.CASH_ID, t7.MDATE, sum(t7.QTY) qty, sum(t7.fpriceAmt) fpriceAmt, sum(nvl(t7.prinAmt, 0)) prinAmt, sum(t7.intAmt) intAmt, t7.SEC_ACCT_ID, t7.PAY_DATE from tmpTable T7 group by T7.FINPROD_ID, t7.CASH_TYPE, t7.CASH_ID, t7.MDATE, t7.SEC_ACCT_ID, t7.PAY_DATE) T8 LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_PLAN T9 ON T8.CASH_ID = T9.CASH_ID AND T8.MDATE = T9.MDATE INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T10 ON T10.FINPROD_ID = T8.FINPROD_ID AND T10.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F07' LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT TC4 ON TC4.FINPROD_ID = T8.SEC_ACCT_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fprod_type on fprod_type.FINPROD_ID = T10.FINPROD_ID WHERE T8.PAY_DATE <= #{checkDate,jdbcType=DATE} GROUP BY t10.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, t10.FINPROD_NAME, t8.SEC_ACCT_ID, TC4.FINPROD_NAME, t8.MDATE, t8.qty, t8.PAY_DATE, fprod_type.TYPE_6, t8.FINPROD_ID

SELECT
T3.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, T2.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, T1.TRADE_ID finprodId, T1.FINPROD_TYPE2 finprodType2, T4.MDATE, T1.PRIN_AMT prinAmt, T4.M_INT_AMT intAmt, T1.PRIN_AMT + T4.M_INT_AMT tradeAmt ,'拆借存续期' remark FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T1 LEFT JOIN PTL_TRADE T3 ON T1.TRADE_ID = T3.BUSI_NO LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO T2 ON T2.PORTFOLIO_ID = T3.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT T4 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T4.FINPROD_ID and t1.BRANCH = t4.BRANCH WHERE T2.INVEST_YESORNO = 'Y' and t4.mdate <= #{checkDate,jdbcType=DATE} and T1.BUSI_TYPE = '01' and t1.TRADE_STATUS = '01' and t1.IS_CANCEL != 'Y' and T1.FINPROD_TYPE2 in ('F08', 'F09', 'F25') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL TPD where TPD.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID AND TPD.PS = 'T23' and TPD.TRADE_STATUS = '01' and TPD.IS_CANCEL = 'N') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL TPD where TPD.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID)

select t8.CASH_TYPE, T10.FINPROD_ID finprodId, T10.CCY, NVL(T5.FINPROD_ABBR, T5.FINPROD_NAME) chlName, T10.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, T10.FINPROD_NAME finprodName, round(SUM(T8.QTY), 4) qty, round(SUM(T8.prinAmt), 4) returnAmount, t8.MDATE, t8.PAY_DATE, ROUND(SUM(T8.prinAmt + t8.intAmt), 4) tradeAmt ,'计划类利率型存续期-'||nvl(T5.FINPROD_ABBR,'直投') remark from ( select T7.FINPROD_ID, T7.AMOUNT QTY, listagg(T7.CASH_TYPE, ',') within group(order by T7.CASH_ID) CASH_TYPE, listagg(T7.CASH_ID, ',') within group(order by T7.CASH_ID) CASH_ID, MIN(T7.VDATE) VDATE, T7.MDATE, T7.SEC_ACCT_ID, MAX(T7.INT_PRIN_AMT) INT_PRIN_AMT, SUM(CASE WHEN T7.CASH_TYPE in ('01', '04') THEN 0 ELSE T7.PRIN_AMT * T7.AMOUNT / T7.CASH_BASEAMT END) prinAmt, SUM(T7.INT_AMT) intAmt, T7.PAY_DATE from ( SELECT T6.FINPROD_ID, SUM(T6.AMOUNT) AMOUNT, T6.CASH_TYPE, T6.CASH_ID, T6.SEC_ACCT_ID, T6.VDATE, T6.MDATE, T6.CASH_AMT, t6.INT_PRIN_AMT, T6.PRIN_AMT, T6.CASH_BASEAMT, sum(t6.INT_AMT) INT_AMT, t6.PAY_DATE from (select T61.FINPROD_ID, T61.AMOUNT, T61.SEC_ACCT_ID, T61.PORTFOLIO_ID, T61.vdate, T61.mdate, T61.cash_amt, T61.prin_amt, T61.cash_id, T61.cash_type, T61.pay_date, T61.INT_PRIN_AMT, case when T61.cash_type IN ('01', '04') then NVL(PSV.TDY_INTINCEXP, (nvl(T61.INT_AMT, 0) - nvl(T61.REPAY_WITHOUT_INT, 0)) * T61.AMOUNT / T61.CASH_BASEAMT) WHEN T61.CASH_TYPE IN ('02', '03') AND nvl(T61.INT_AMT, 0) - nvl(T61.REPAY_WITHOUT_INT, 0) != 0 AND PSV.SHARE_AMT is not null THEN ROUND(T61.PRIN_AMT * T61.AMOUNT / T61.CASH_BASEAMT * PSV.TDY_INTINCEXP / PSV.SHARE_AMT, 2) else (nvl(T61.INT_AMT, 0) - nvl(T61.REPAY_WITHOUT_INT, 0)) * t61.AMOUNT / t61.CASH_BASEAMT end int_amt, T61.CASH_BASEAMT from ( SELECT T1.FINPROD_ID, T1.AMOUNT, T1.SEC_ACCT_ID, T1.PORTFOLIO_ID, t2.vdate, t2.mdate, t2.cash_amt, t2.prin_amt, t2.cash_id, t2.cash_type, t2.pay_date, t2.INT_PRIN_AMT, t2.CASH_BASEAMT, T2.INT_AMT, T2.REPAY_WITHOUT_INT FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION T1 INNER JOIN FIN_CASH_PLAN T2 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T2.FINPROD_ID AND T2.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F17' AND t1.CDATE < t2.MDATE inner join PTL_PORTFOLIO pp on T1.PORTFOLIO_ID = pp.PORTFOLIO_ID WHERE T1.AMOUNT > 0 AND T1.HODING_TYPE = '03' and T2.CASH_TYPE IN ('01', '02', '03', '04') and (t2.INT_AMT > 0 or t2.PRIN_AMT > 0) and t2.mdate = (select max(tt.mdate) from FIN_CASH_PLAN tt where tt.finprod_id = t1.finprod_id AND tt.MDATE > t1.CDATE AND Tt.PAY_DATE <= #{checkDate,jdbcType=DATE} ) and NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL TPDA where TPDA.TRADE_STATUS = '01' AND TPDA.IS_CANCEL = 'N' and T2.MDATE = TPDA.MDATE AND TPDA.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID AND T1.PORTFOLIO_ID = TPDA.PORTFOLIO_ID AND ((TPDA.CHL_ID is NULL and t1.sec_acct_id = '999999') OR TPDA.CHL_ID = T1.SEC_ACCT_ID)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL TPDA where TPDA.TRADE_STATUS = '01' AND TPDA.IS_CANCEL = 'N' and T2.MDATE >= TPDA.MDATE AND TPDA.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID AND T1.PORTFOLIO_ID = TPDA.PORTFOLIO_ID AND ((TPDA.CHL_ID is NULL and t1.sec_acct_id = '999999') OR TPDA.CHL_ID = T1.SEC_ACCT_ID)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION tpsp where tpsp.HODING_TYPE = '03' and tpsp.PORTFOLIO_ID = T1.PORTFOLIO_ID and tpsp.SEC_ACCT_ID = T1.SEC_ACCT_ID and tpsp.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID and tpsp.CDATE > T1.CDATE and tpsp.CDATE < t2.MDATE) and nvl(pp.PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID, 'null') = 'null' and T2.PAY_DATE <= #{checkDate,jdbcType=DATE} ) T61 LEFT JOIN PTL_SEC_VALUTION PSV ON t61.MDATE = PSV.CDATE + 1 AND T61.PORTFOLIO_ID = PSV.PORTFOLIO_ID AND T61.FINPROD_ID = PSV.FINPROD_ID AND PSV.INV_AIM = '999999') T6 GROUP BY T6.FINPROD_ID, T6.SEC_ACCT_ID, T6.CASH_TYPE, T6.CASH_ID, T6.VDATE, T6.MDATE, T6.CASH_AMT, t6.INT_PRIN_AMT, T6.PRIN_AMT, T6.CASH_BASEAMT, t6.PAY_DATE ) T7 GROUP BY T7.FINPROD_ID, T7.AMOUNT, T7.SEC_ACCT_ID, T7.MDATE, T7.PAY_DATE ) T8 LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T10 ON T10.FINPROD_ID = T8.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE fccr ON instr(T8.CASH_ID, fccr.CASH_ID) > 0 AND fccr.EFF_DATE <= T8.MDATE LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T5 ON T8.SEC_ACCT_ID = T5.FINPROD_ID WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE T6 WHERE fccr.CASH_ID = T6.CASH_ID AND T6.EFF_DATE <= T8.MDATE AND T6.EFF_DATE > fccr.EFF_DATE) and T8.PAY_DATE <= #{checkDate,jdbcType=DATE} and T10.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F17' AND T10.PROFIT_TYPE = '02' GROUP BY t8.CASH_TYPE, T10.FINPROD_ID, T10.CCY, t8.SEC_ACCT_ID, T10.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, T10.FINPROD_NAME, T5.FINPROD_ABBR, T5.FINPROD_NAME, fccr.YIELD, t8.MDATE, t8.PAY_DATE

SUM(T7.INT_AMT * T7.AMOUNT / T7.CASH_BASEAMT) intAmt, T7.PAY_DATE from (SELECT t6.FINPROD_ID, t6.PORTFOLIO_ID, t6.AMOUNT, T6.SEC_ACCT_ID, T6.CASH_TYPE, T6.CASH_ID, T6.VDATE, T6.MDATE, T6.CASH_AMT,
